title: AERIS-AQ
subtitle: AI agent for air quality analysis across African cities
description: An air-quality decision-support API for operational and policy workflows. AERIS-AQ provides accurate, source-aware air-quality responses and conservative health guidance through a conversational AI agent with multi-source data integration.
problem: Air quality data across African cities is fragmented across multiple sources (WAQI, AirQo, OpenMeteo, DEFRA, UBA, NSW) and difficult to interpret without specialized knowledge. Communities and policymakers need an AI-powered assistant that can synthesize data from multiple sources, answer questions in natural language, and provide actionable health guidance.
role: Built the complete system — Python backend with LangGraph agent orchestration, multi-source air quality data integration, conversational session management, and a TypeScript/React frontend with chat interface, session history, and animated UI. Handled free-tier cold-start behavior for deployment on Render.
approach: Built with FastAPI backend, Gemini AI provider, SQLite for session storage, and multi-source data integration (WAQI, AirQo, OpenMeteo, Carbon Intensity, DEFRA, UBA, NSW). Uses a clean architecture pattern with domain services, infrastructure layer, and REST API interfaces. Includes health endpoints, readiness gates, and cold-start handling for free-tier deployments. Frontend uses Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and SWR for data fetching.
hardestDecision: Implementing free-tier cold-start behavior — the deployment on Render sleeps during inactivity, requiring a warmup window where the API returns 503 with retry-after headers. Needed to handle this gracefully across all endpoints including chat, health checks, and session management without confusing clients.
outcome: Live at aeris.ochiengpaul.com and agent-frontend-seven.vercel.app. 216 commits on GitHub. Integrates 7 air quality data sources with conversational AI interface.
whatIdChange: Would implement response caching for common air quality queries, add streaming responses for better UX during long agent reasoning chains, and add a fact-checking layer that cross-references agent responses against verified data endpoints.
